Cooper Flagg has 25 points, career-best 12 assists as Mavericks beat Nets 130-93

DALLAS (AP) — Cooper Flagg had 25 points and a career-high 12 assists for his third consecutive double-double and fourth of the season as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Brooklyn Nets 130-93 on Sunday night.
